mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly GDP growth rate above 2.0% in GDPC1 signals robust economic expansion, increasing corporate earnings expectations and reducing equity risk premiums, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth rate > 2.0% fails to produce positive 20d returns in > 40% of instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points from the prior month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative equity returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rise > 0.3pp fails to produce negative 5d returns in > 45% of instances, or t-test p-value > 0.05 vs baseline.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in FEDFUNDS below 2.0% and CPIAUCSL above 255.0 indicates accommodative monetary policy amid persistent inflation, compressing equity discount rates and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: Joint signal fails to yield positive 20d returns in > 55% of instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production decline below 100.0 indicates manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate output capacity and triggering negative equity returns during late-cycle economic regimes over 60 days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 100.0 fails to produce negative 60d returns in > 50% of instances, or SPX 60d returns exceed -0.5% in 70% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly payroll employment decline exceeding 100k signals weakening labor demand, increasing recession risk and driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS decline > 100k fails to generate negative 5d returns in > 45% of instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year periods.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 1200 thousand units signals strong consumer demand for durable goods, boosting retail sales and corporate revenue growth, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: HOUST > 1200.0 fails to produce positive 20d returns in > 55% of cases, or SPX 20d returns < 0.3% in 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous GDP growth above 2.0% in GDPC1 and housing starts above 1200 thousand units indicates synchronized demand expansion, accelerating corporate earnings growth and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: Joint signal fails to yield positive 60d returns in > 55% of instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 258.0 in high-inflation regimes signals persistent price pressures, prompting central bank rate hikes that increase equity discount rates and drive negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 258.0 fails to produce negative 20d returns in > 50% of instances, or SPX 20d returns exceed -0.2% in 65% of cases.
